about_the_game:
Step into a story-driven point & click adventure that blends mystery with challenge. As you explore eerie locations, you’ll search for cleverly concealed objects, solve puzzles, and piece together a dark tale that unfolds one discovery at a time. Each scene demands sharp eyes and a curious mind, making every moment of play an engaging test of observation and logic.

What begins as a simple night of thrills at a haunted castle quickly descends into terror. Three friends set out to prove their courage, but their dares awaken something far older—and far deadlier—than they imagined. Shadows twist into nightmares, one of them disappears, and the survivors, Alex and Kate, must face the forgotten legacy of the witches of Darkhand Castle. To uncover the truth, they must dive deep into cursed history where the past refuses to stay buried.

From haunted corridors to cursed relics, every step forward hides a new test. Players will enjoy a variety of puzzles—ranging from intricate hidden object scenes to inventive mini-games—that keep the suspense alive and the mind sharp. No two challenges feel the same, ensuring a thrilling experience from beginning to end!

Features:

🎃 Discover cursed relics tied to the witches—do you dare touch them?

🎃 Solve dozens of eerie puzzles and sinister mini-games.

🎃 Explore spooky hidden object scenes and unravel chilling mysteries.

🎃 Collect curious items and hidden secrets throughout your journey.

🎃 Earn achievements and uncover shocking story revelations.

Step into the darkness, where every shadow hides a secret and every puzzle brings you closer to the blood vow that binds the cursed forever. Will you survive the night?
